biggest_catch: The 'up to $486' is a conditional maximum, not a guarantee: it requires being 50-64, passing medical screening, receiving an investigational COVID-19 vaccine, and completing the full visit schedule across a 2+ month study window.
catches: 'Up to $486' is a conditional maximum, not a guarantee: payout depends on visits completed.
Medical screening gate: ages 50-64, in general good health, no COVID infection or vaccine in the past 3 months - not everyone qualifies.
Investigational vaccine study with real medical risks disclosed in informed consent; you may receive placebo or the investigational vaccine.
Time commitment: screening plus multiple in-clinic vaccination and follow-up visits over weeks/months; travel to a Tekton site required (Austin TX, Oklahoma City, Wichita, Denver, etc.).

c1.evidence: Tekton Research is a real multi-site clinical research organization (founded Austin TX 2006, ~25,000 study participants per its own site); tektonresearch.com is its official domain.

c2.evidence: Official study page states 'Qualified participants may be compensated up to $486 for time and travel' plus age/health eligibility criteria and that the study is now enrolling.

c3.evidence: No fee to participate; 'Do not need insurance to join'; participants are paid compensation for time and travel.

c4.evidence: Compensation cap, eligibility criteria, no-insurance statement, and study locations stated on the official study page.

eligibility: Ages 50-64; in general good health without underlying conditions raising severe-COVID risk; no COVID infection or COVID vaccine in the past 3 months; must pass screening.
notes: Tekton Research (Austin TX-based CRO, founded 2006) official study page, verified live 2026-09-23: 'Now Enrolling Adults Ages 50-64' for an investigational COVID-19 vaccine; qualified participants 'may be compensated up to $486 for time and travel.' Framed honestly: 'up to' is a ceiling, screening gates apply, investigational vaccine risks.
payout_quote: Tekton Research is now enrolling for a research study evaluating an investigational vaccine for COVID-19. Qualified participants may be compensated up to $486 for time and travel.
payout_value_note: 'Up to $486' is the provider-stated compensation ceiling for qualified participants; no floor stated, so min = 0.

s1.note: Age 50-64, general good health, no COVID infection/vaccine in past 3 months stated on the official page.

s2.note: Compensation is for time and travel, conditional on qualifying and participating.

s3.note: Compensation paid for participation-related time and travel.

s4.note: Stated as participant compensation for time and travel, not wages.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: apply online/call, speak with enrollment specialist, pass screening, complete visits.

steps: Open the Tekton Research COVID-19 vaccine study page and complete the online sign-up form, or call (855) 248-2556.
A Tekton enrollment specialist calls to discuss the study and confirm initial fit (age 50-64, general good health, no COVID infection/vaccine in past 3 months).
Attend a screening visit and pass the eligibility screening.
Receive the investigational vaccine (or assigned study treatment) and complete the scheduled study visits over the study period.
Receive compensation of up to $486 for time and travel.
timing: Compensation paid for study-related time and travel; Tekton's site FAQ states participants are compensated for completed visits/phone calls/diary entries, with the exact schedule explained before you decide.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms (up to $486 ceiling, no floor -> min 0); time: online form + specialist call + screening + multi-visit vaccination schedule est. 120-240 min active
